query:
INSERT INTO bots (id, name, description, source_code, is_active, is_public, is_system, is_valid)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 1, 1, 1)
               ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
                   name = excluded.name,
                   description = excluded.description,
                   source_code = excluded.source_code,
                   is_active = 1,
                   is_public = 1,
                   is_valid = 1
